title: Polish Feta Fritters
description: A crispy and savory fritter filled with Polish flavors and topped with feta. The perfect snack or light meal.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together polish and feta.
Add chopped nutty to the bowl and mix well.
Open fritter package and separate the fritters.
Dip each fritter into the polish and feta mixture.
Place the fritters in the hot oil and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Flip the fritters and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy!
Optional: Serve with a side of cheese for dipping.
